title: Efficacy and Safety of Atorvastatin in Combination With Radiotherapy and Temozolomide in Glioblastoma

sections.abstract: The purpose of this study is to explore the efficacy and safety of Atorvastatin in combination with multimodality therapy of concurrent radiotherapy plus temozolomide followed by adjuvant temozolomide in patients with newly diagnosed glioblastoma multiforme (GBM).The anticipated time on study treatment is until disease progression, and the target sample size is 32 individuals.
